title: Daqar exxal yan dacrise
intro: Qangiinoh amri mango buxaaxil rooka bahte baaxol, inki rooci inkih tan meysi saduh yan farmo hirge. Aamanti kibbiimeh yan sorkocô baxat, agattiinah gexso milaagtah tan imaan abto qemmisen. Lee gaalik tan quuka elle quuken innal, qaago leeh addat tangale.
clues: Anu zulmii kee meysi waktil mannoowak suge.
Anu alliiliyya yoh teceeh tan qibaadah uguugus gee.
Anu mameysitaanam akkek rookitaanam akah amrisan innah abeh suge.
Anu inni alqi alil daffeeseeh leeh amol daffeese.
Yi baxi buxah marih gabat geytimeh, takkay immay yok gersi baxi kattaate.
Yalli elle xagana kah cule innah, inni baxat kaa yaysarusuh qagitak ongooroweh suge.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Awki alla xeerih yan baaxo fan beenih yenen.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
